statement_nl: The hypotheses of L5 are now all verified for the weights w_j from A4: V(s) has no consecutive elements by A6, E_0 = 1 by A7, every E_m is positive by A9, and the parity convolution identities hold by A8. Therefore L5 gives sum over j in V(s) of w_j <= max( sum over odd j with 1 <= j <= n of w_j, sum over even j with 1 <= j <= n of w_j ). Combining this with A5 also gives F(s) <= max( sum over odd j of w_j, sum over even j of w_j ).
